event: Random addresses up to max size; exact 2MB boundary and above-2MB not checked.

I submitted the verdict as verified: the gap in the finding stands.

The only test that touches this is `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_valid_user`. When the SRAM is smaller than the 2MB maximum, it writes to five random addresses between the end of the SRAM and the 2MB maximum, then fails if any read-back isn't 0.

Nothing checks the exact 2MB top, the last valid SRAM word, or that an address just above 2MB is not claimed by the MBOX. I saw no test that varies the SRAM size. I did not read the RTL or look in detail at the other test directories.
